plan.purpose: Compare actual Swift managed-model inputs and teacher-forced talker/code-predictor logits to the unmodified Python MLX reference; no default or production change
validity_requirements: Swift known-failure first-codebook token prefix must exactly match retained seed196 baseline
All five input cases must retain original declared parameters
Both implementations use the same locked 8-bit weights and no outbound model access
Compare Python text tokenization and prepared inputs, then feed identical native codec vectors without random sampling in Python
Report shape/dtype/exactness/max/mean/RMS differences and EOS diagnostics for every retained step
A numerical mismatch is a lead for further localization, not automatic proof of an SDK defect; no production promotion or quality pass from this probe
